# kvindo_kafka_user (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kvindo_kafka" "main" {
  name = "main"
}

resource "kvindo_kafka_user" "app" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "app-user"
    folder_id = data.kvindo_kafka.main.metadata.folder_id
  }
  spec = {
    kafka_id = data.kvindo_kafka.main.metadata.id
    password = "'change-me'"
    enabled  = true

    # Role-based, not raw ACL tuples: the platform expands "produce to orders" into the
    # operations Kafka actually needs.
    topic_grants = [
      { topic_pattern = "orders", pattern_type = "Literal", role = "Producer" },
      { topic_pattern = "orders-", pattern_type = "Prefixed", role = "Consumer" },
    ]

    # REQUIRED as soon as any grant is a Consumer: a consumer without group access cannot
    # commit offsets, so the request is rejected at submit time.
    consumer_group_prefixes = ["app-"]
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Optional:

- `cluster_operations` (List of String) Cluster-scoped ACLs: `Describe` (a read-only admin UI) or `IdempotentWrite` (a producing UI). Empty means none, which is every ordinary producer/consumer. Only a tenant-run tool needs these, and `Create` is deliberately not offered - it would bypass the KafkaTopic resource model.
- `consumer_group_prefixes` (List of String) Consumer-group ACLs, prefix-matched; `"*"` is an accepted explicit value for all groups. REQUIRED as soon as any grant is a `Consumer` - a consumer that cannot reach its group cannot commit offsets, so the request is rejected at submit time rather than failing later with an authorization error that points nowhere useful.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Authentication switch. `false` LOCKS the user: the SCRAM credential is overwritten with an unusable random password while every ACL stays in place, so re-enabling is one write instead of a full re-grant.
- `kafka_id` (String) The cluster this SCRAM principal belongs to. Immutable - a user cannot move between clusters.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Write-only: the backend never returns this value on read. If configured, its value is preserved in state rather than overwritten by the always-empty read-back. Unlike valkey_user/postgresql_user there is NO server-side generation: KafkaUserResourceController rejects a CREATE with `enabled` true and an empty password (`KafkaUser requires Password when Enabled is true`), so it must be supplied - a create with `enabled` false and no password is allowed (a pre-locked principal). Omitting it on a MODIFY is legitimate and carries the existing credential forward from the change request.
- `topic_grants` (Attributes List) Role-based grants, not raw Kafka ACL tuples: `Producer` or `Consumer` on a `Literal` topic name or a `Prefixed` pattern, and the platform expands each into the operations Kafka actually needs (Write+Describe, or Read+Describe plus the group ACLs). There is no Admin role in this release. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--topic_grants))
